result.quote: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
result.reason: The passage explicitly says Uzziah followed his father’s example by doing what was right in the LORD’s eyes. It also says Uzziah sought God, but does not identify that action as following his father’s example. Thus the key adds an unsupported detail; the uniquely supported answer is that he did what was right in the LORD’s eyes.
